title: RHEL Patch with Pre/Post Health Checks
description: Updates all packages on a RHEL server, reboots, and validates memory, disk space, and running services before and after the patch.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: Target RHEL server hostname or IP address.

parameters.name: min_free_memory_gb
parameters.description: Minimum required free memory in GB before and after patching.

parameters.name: min_free_disk_gb
parameters.description: Minimum required free disk space in GB per filesystem before and after patching.

parameters.name: fs_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of mount points to exclude from disk space checks.

parameters.name: fs_type_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of filesystem types to exclude from disk space checks.

parameters.name: msg
parameters.description: Message to display to users before reboot.

parameters.name: reboot_timeout
parameters.description: Maximum seconds to wait for machine to reboot and respond to a test command.

parameters.name: package_name
parameters.description: Package name(s) to update. Use '*' to update all packages.

parameters.name: package_state
parameters.description: Desired state of the package(s). Use 'latest' to update to the newest available version.

playbook_output.description: Structured report of patching steps and results.

fields.name: overall_status
fields.description: Overall status - always 'SUCCESS' when this report is emitted.

fields.name: pre_memory_free_gb
fields.description: Free memory in GB before patching.

fields.name: pre_disk_status
fields.description: Pre-patch disk check status (always 'ok' if report emitted).

fields.name: update_status
fields.description: Package update status (always 'ok' if report emitted).

fields.name: post_memory_free_gb
fields.description: Free memory in GB after patching.

fields.name: post_disk_status
fields.description: Post-patch disk check status (always 'ok' if report emitted).

fields.name: pre_running_services_count
fields.description: Number of running services before patching.

fields.name: post_running_services_count
fields.description: Number of running services after patching.

fields.name: service_mismatches
fields.description: List of differing services between pre and post patch (descriptive strings).

steps.name: Gather pre-patch system facts
steps.function: Collect memory and mount facts from the target using ansible.builtin.setup.

steps.name: Extract pre-patch memory and filter mounts
steps.function: Compute free memory in GB and filter out excluded filesystems/mounts from the mount data.

computations._pre_mounts_filtered: Filter ansible_facts.mounts to exclude mounts where mount is in fs_exclude_list (after splitting and trimming) or where fstype is in fs_type_exclude_list (after splitting and trimming). Keep mount, size_available, fstype.

steps.name: Check pre-patch free memory
steps.function: Abort if free memory is below the threshold; otherwise continue to disk check.
steps.condition: Pre-patch free memory (GB) is below min_free_memory_gb.

steps.name: Check pre-patch disk space
steps.function: Abort if any filtered mount has available space below the threshold; otherwise continue to service collection.
steps.condition: At least one mount point in the pre-patch filtered mount list has available space below min_free_disk_gb GB.

steps.name: Collect pre-patch running services
steps.function: Gather running systemd services before patching.

steps.name: Extract pre-patch service list and count
steps.function: Extract the list of running service names and compute the count.

computations._pre_running_services: Get list of service names where state is 'running' from _pre_service_facts_raw.services, sorted ascending.
computations._pre_running_services_count: Number of running services (length of the list).

steps.name: Update all packages
steps.function: Apply all available package updates using the idempotent package module.

steps.name: Reboot the server
steps.function: Reboot the target server and wait for it to come back online.

steps.name: Gather post-patch system facts
steps.function: Collect memory and mount facts after the reboot.

steps.name: Extract post-patch memory and filter mounts
steps.function: Compute free memory in GB and filter out excluded filesystems/mounts from the post-reboot data.

computations._post_mounts_filtered: Filter ansible_facts.mounts to exclude mounts where mount is in fs_exclude_list (after splitting and trimming) or where fstype is in fs_type_exclude_list (after splitting and trimming). Keep mount, size_available, fstype.

steps.name: Check post-patch free memory
steps.function: Abort if free memory is below the threshold; otherwise continue to disk check.
steps.condition: Post-patch free memory (GB) is below min_free_memory_gb.

steps.name: Check post-patch disk space
steps.function: Abort if any filtered mount has available space below the threshold; otherwise continue to service collection.
steps.condition: At least one mount point in the post-patch filtered mount list has available space below min_free_disk_gb GB.

steps.name: Collect post-patch running services
steps.function: Gather running systemd services after patching.

steps.name: Extract post-patch service list and count
steps.function: Extract the list of running service names and compute the count.

computations._post_running_services: Get list of service names where state is 'running' from _post_service_facts_raw.services, sorted ascending.
computations._post_running_services_count: Number of running services (length of the list).

steps.name: Compare service lists
steps.function: Find services present in only one of the pre or post lists.

computations._service_mismatches: Compute symmetric difference between _pre_running_services and _post_running_services, producing a list of descriptive strings (e.g., 'only in pre: serviceX', 'only in post: serviceY').

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Validate memory, disk space, and capture running services before updating.

phases.name: Reboot
phases.description: Reboot the server and wait for it to return.

phases.name: Post-checks
phases.description: Re-validate memory, disk space, and compare running services after the patch.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured final report to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
